name: Frog Stretch
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then slide your knees out wide and keep your inner feet on the floor with your ankles in line with your knees.
Sink your hips back toward your heels.
Hold the position, keeping your back flat.
Come out of it slowly and stop if you feel pinching in the groin or knees.
image_prompt_scene: On hands and knees with the knees wide and the inner feet on the floor.
